rumour: They say a door stands open somewhere below, and that whoever finds it forgets the way back.
I have heard the stairs go on without end. I have also heard they do not. I believe both.
Some say the way out is a rumour the deep feeds us to keep us walking. Keep walking anyway.
The first door shut behind you. They say the last one opens for those who stop looking.
Every faction tells it differently. All of them say the way out is down.
Those who come back up are never the ones who went down.
stair: The stair turns once more, and the air #air#.
The stair is worn hollow by feet that did not come back up.
air: smells of wet stone and tallow
hums, very faintly, with something far beneath
below: water drips into a pool no one has seen
a bell rings that has no rope
something drags its chain from one room to the next
a torch gutters in a hand that is not yours
counsel: Keep your light close. The dark does not keep you.
Eat when you can, sleep when you must, and count your coin twice.
Not every door is a way out. Some are only a way further in.
A pack is light until the third stair.
